title: House Benghazi Committee Report (2016)
summary: ~800 pages on the Sept 11, 2012 attack that killed Ambassador Stevens and three others: State failed to protect diplomats; CIA misread Libya's danger; DOD assets never reached Benghazi in time. Also found: NO new evidence of culpability by Clinton; NO 'stand down' order was issued; US forces in Europe could not have arrived in time.

sources.label: House Select Committee on Benghazi — official govinfo collection (H. Rept. 114-848)

tldr: The House Select Committee's 2016 final report found the State Department failed to protect its people, the CIA misread Libya's danger, and no U.S. military asset ever reached Benghazi — while finding no wrongdoing by Hillary Clinton and no stand-down order.
ai_summary:
AI review of H. Rept. 114-848, the Final Report of the Select Committee on the Events Surrounding the 2012 Terrorist Attack in Benghazi (govinfo, Dec 2016), read in key sections:
- Scale: committee created by House vote 232–186 on May 8, 2014, chaired by Trey Gowdy, with a $3.3 million budget; the final report was released June 28, 2016, and the committee closed December 12, 2016.
- Stand-down question: the CIA Chief of Base in Benghazi testified under oath, "I did not, I did not tell anybody to stand down" — and added, "I did not issue a stand-down order. And if there was a delay, there was a very short delay," while securing a gun truck for the rescue team.
- Military response: the report records that U.S. military forces did not reach Benghazi until mid-afternoon the day after the attack; Chairman Gowdy stated, "No U.S. military asset was ever deployed to Benghazi despite the order of the Secretary of Defense at 7 o'clock that night."
- Clinton: she testified October 22, 2015 for over eight hours in a public hearing; the committee's own overview states "The report itself found no wrongdoing by Hillary Clinton," while the Democratic minority acknowledged "security measures in Benghazi were woefully inadequate."
- The summary's core claims (State failed to protect, CIA misread danger, DOD never arrived in time, no Clinton culpability, no stand-down order) are verified accurate against the document.
